classification.difficultyReason: The student must match the sides of two triangles in size order (shortest to shortest, and so on) and compute three ratios. All three ratios equal 3, so there is no near-miss to interpret.

content.prompt: Decide whether these triangles are similar by checking if corresponding sides are in equal ratio.

answer.worked:
Match the shortest sides, the middle sides and the longest sides.
$$\begin{align*}\frac{15}{5}&=3\\\frac{18}{6}&=3\\\frac{24}{8}&=3\end{align*}$$
The corresponding sides have the same ratio, so the triangles are similar.
